question:
What is the average age of patients as of year 1999 examined in the laboratory for the October of the year 1991?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: average age of patients as of year 1999 refers to AVG(SUBTRACT('1999', year(Birthday))); October of 1991 refers to Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
